questions.question: Which river flows through the city that hosts the northern observatory?
context: Northern Observatory
The Northern Observatory is located in the city of Aldmere.
It was completed in 1974 and is operated by a regional trust.
Its primary instrument is a 2.1 metre reflector.
Aldmere Transit
Aldmere transit services run every eleven minutes at peak time.
The tram network was extended to the harbour in 2011.
Fares are collected on board and on the platform.
City of Aldmere
Aldmere is a coastal city with a population of roughly 90,000.
The old town sits on a headland above the estuary.
The Varn flows through the city before reaching the sea.
River Varn
The Varn rises in the hills east of Aldmere.
It has been heavily modified for navigation since the 1800s.
Its tidal limit is now just below the old town.
